text: 13.2 1 What was the weather like in Greece? Was it hot? Yeah, it was boiling. Over 40 degrees most days. 2 What was the weather like in Finland? Was it cold? Yeah, it was freezing. Around minus 10 most days. 3 What was Istanbul like? It's quite a big city, isn't it? Yeah, it's huge. The population's around 12 million. Four What was the food like in Italy? Was it good? Great. Really delicious. They really know how to eat. Five So what was your trip like? Was it good? Yeah, it was fantastic. We had a great time. Six How was the journey back? Did you get wet in that storm? We got absolutely soaked. I didn't have an umbrella or anything. Seven You must be very angry about them losing your luggage. I am. I'm absolutely furious. Eight You must be tired after such a long journey. Yeah, I am. I'm exhausted. I'm ready for bed. Nine You must be hungry after such a long journey. I am. I'm starving. Have you got anything to eat? Ten It's supposed to be quite a dirty city, isn't it? Yeah, it was really filthy. I couldn't believe it. It's supposed to be quite crowded, isn't it? Yeah, it was. It was absolutely packed when we went. Twelve. Tabriz is supposed to be quite an interesting city. Yeah, it's fascinating. It dates back over a thousand years.
